name: ease-sway
story: Standing in profile, her hand on her bump as a tightening eases. She sways her weight slowly from her back foot to her front foot, the bump settling after her hips, and breathes out. Then her eyes lift from her bump to her packed bag on the floor by the door ahead of her, and she smiles. Ends on a held pose (Braxton Hicks story, direction A).
intensity: very gentle and calm: a slow sway, small soft moves, nothing fast
handsBoxNote: film px holding the hand on her bump all shot: blind_ab.py and critic_F.py draw it at 1:1 and its motion per second (lesson 58)
note: For the Braxton Hicks story (every direction): weight back, weight front, settled, then the look with the smile. Keys derived from n-bump (refs/derive_breathe.sh): the legs tilt from the ankles, plantFeet ik keeps the feet planted.

beats.name: settle, the bump after the hips
eyes lift to the bag, smile

keys.note: v2: opens already drifting back (feel review v1: 'the opening weight back doesn't register', 0–0.4 s a standstill)
the weight on the back foot; then the sway: a slow ease in and a long ease out
weight on the front foot, the back knee soft, the shoulders settled on the breath out
eases back a touch and settles
the head lifts after the eyes (eyes from 3.6, head from ~3.7) to look at the bag by the door
held: the story cuts on this pose

near.note: the hand rests on the lower front of her bump all shot (breathe-stroke's n-bump contact), riding the sway
v2: the rub starts as the weight comes forward
as the tightening eases she rubs her bump: a slow stroke ~7 px up its front with the sway, and back (a hand only carried by her body reads stuck on: QA alive, lesson 51)

keys.note: v2: the lips part on the breath out (1.4–2.8 s) and the lids lower a touch (feel review v1: 'the release rests on a tiny change of mouth shape')
the tightening has passed: the mouth closes, calm

the eyes lift to the bag FIRST, through a blink (3.6 s), the head follows; v2: the upper lid kept part way down, the bag is on the floor (feel review v1: 'the fully round, unlidded eye reads as alert, almost blank')
the smile blooms and reaches her eyes: v2 the cheek lifts the lower lid (lid smile .45)

breath.note: v2: the breath out (1.4–2.8 s, with the sway forward) at 1.7× so the tightening's release shows in the chest and shoulders; then 1.25× so the hold breathes (feel review v1: 'held from the neck down')

events.note: a blink carries the eyes up to the bag

fidget.note: v2: as the hips drift back the trunk trails a touch forward
v2: as the hips go forward the trunk trails them (leans back ~15 px at the head), so the hips lead, the chest and head follow (feel review v1: 'a cut-out on a pivot')
v2: and follows through as the hips stop (overlap)
the bump settles after the hips: it carries on forward as they stop (2.6 s) and comes back
v2: the fingers ease onto the bump as the tightening passes, little finger first, 2–3 frames apart (feel review v1: 'the four fingers shift together as one stacked block… like a comb')
as her eyes go to the bag the hand gives the bump a small press (turns ~4° and back), the thumb with it
v2: the press's finger curl in a cascade, little finger first
as she smiles, a small open of the fingers on the bump (breathe-stroke 7.95–9.15 s)
v2: the index and middle lift a touch, one after the other
v2: the hold keeps a faint drift of her weight back (feel review v1: 'held from the neck down'); plantFeet keeps the feet

near: the last beat is her face: her eyes go to the bag and she smiles, the hand resting on her bump (a small press at 3.3–4.9 s and an open of the fingers 4.2–5.6 s); then the held end pose the story cuts on
